entities.summary: Victor Vladimirovich Antipin is a Kazakh-born Russian professional ice hockey defenceman who is currently an unrestricted free agent. He most recently played for Barys Astana in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He has previously played in the National Hockey League (NHL) with the Buffalo Sabres. He is the son of Vladimir Antipin.
